rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and ZIP to a single account before accessing order details. It correctly stated that split payments aren’t supported, retrieved the user’s latest order, accurately identified the most expensive item and its price, and confirmed the order status was pending. Before performing a write (cancelling the order), the agent clearly stated the action and obtained explicit confirmation including a reason. It then used the appropriate tool to cancel the order, and the tool output confirms the refund and cancelled status. Final details (order total, last four of card, refund) align with tool results. Minor issues: the agent asserted individual-item cancellation wasn’t supported and suggested modification options without tool evidence, and quoted a 5–7 business day refund window not sourced from tools. However, these did not affect the correctness of the completed request, which adhered to policy.
